Management Summary

🔵 The market is real — and measured

We sized the plant-protein niche bottom-up from actual Amazon sales badges, deduplicated by product family: Germany ≈ €525k/month, US ≈ $9.0M/month — page-1 products only, so if anything an undercount.

🟢 Your USP fits what buyers now want

"Good source of protein" is the #1 definition of healthy food for the first time (IFIC 2025), ~3 in 4 shoppers re-check ingredient lists, and 40%+ of supplement buyers look for third-party testing — exactly Naturally's story: 6 ingredients, no gums or fillers, tested.

🟡 A small share is real money

A modest 1% of the German niche ≈ €5,622/month; 0.5% of the US niche ≈ $51k/month — revenue potential, not profit, derived with 4 built-in plausibility guards.

Competition — two very different games

Who counts as a competitor here: the best-selling plant-based protein families from our page-1 scan (ranked by Amazon's own "bought last month" data). Whey/dairy giants like ESN, Optimum Nutrition or Dymatize sell a different product — they don't even rank on page 1 for plant-protein searches and are excluded.

Germany — fragmented: top brand Volksshake holds only 17.9%

US — concentrated: Orgain alone holds ~47.3%

Bars = review counts of the top sellers (reviews are Amazon's strongest conversion lever). Germany's tallest review wall is ~2,400 — a gap a new brand can close. In the US, Orgain sits at 62,000+ reviews — there we grow in the premium clean-label corner, not head-on. Naturally starts at 0 — the review ramp IS the launch strategy.

Source: live listing data of the shown families (Keepa + Apify, Aug 14, 2026) · brand shares unit-weighted from Amazon badge data

What it takes to launch — no surprises

1
EU importer of record: an EU-based food business operator must appear on every label (Reg. EU 1169/2011)
2
Label redesign: German LMIV label for DE · FDA Nutrition/Supplement Facts panel for US
3
FDA stack (US): facility registration + U.S. agent, FSVP importer, prior notice per shipment
4
LUCID (DE): packaging registration — Amazon blocks listings without it
5
Landed cost: ~12.8% EU duty + import VAT · ~25% total US tariff on Indonesian goods (2025/26, volatile; EU-Indonesia CEPA may cut EU duties from 2027)
6
Ocean freight: Bali → Hamburg 5–7 weeks · → US West Coast 3–4 weeks, plus customs + FBA receiving
7
Shelf life: Amazon requires 105+ days remaining shelf life at FBA check-in
~4–6 monthsfrom decision to first unit live — US typically a few weeks faster than Germany

Slide-level summary of sourced research (EU Reg. 1169/2011, FDA/FSMA, Amazon seller docs, freight benchmarks) — items marked for professional legal/customs review before committing. Adlevate coordinates this entire path.

Opportunities & risks — both sides

🟢 Opportunities

• German niche growing ~+43% YoY with a low review wall (~2,400 max)
• Clean-label combination (6 ingredients + tested) rarely claimed together
• Premium price segment underweighted in DE (19.4% of units)
• "Made in Bali" is a real story competitors can't copy
• EU-Indonesia trade deal may cut EU duties from 2027

🔴 Risks

• Review ramp from zero takes 6–12 months of consistent execution
• US: Orgain's dominance + ~25% tariff on Indonesian goods squeeze margins
• Compliance path (EU importer, FDA, labels) costs time & money upfront
• Corridor = revenue, not profit — COGS & logistics from Bali not yet modeled
• PPC costs in supplement niches are significant during ranking phase

Sources: own market, seasonality & corridor analysis (Aug 2026) + sourced compliance research — details on the preceding slides
